paragraphs: Shmuel bar Nahum, the maternal uncle—some say maternal grandfather—of Rav Aha bar Hanina. He spoke to R' Tanhum bar Hanilai, R' Yehoshua ben Levi's pupil: Bava Kamma 55a; Shoher Tov, no. 139; and Midrash Hazit, at “Return, return.” And R' Hanan son of R' Berekhiah, in R' Yirmeyah's name. But in Yalkut Shir ha-Shirim, at “Return, return, O Shulamite”: R' Shmuel bar Tanhuma, R' Hanin bar Rabbi, and R' Berekhiah ben Tzeruyah, in R' Idi's name. In Bereshit Rabbah, Toledot, beginning of chapter 66, this matter reads: R' Shmuel bar Tanhum and R' Hanin, in R' Idi's name.
